title: rRDP: Interface to the RDP Classifier
text: rRDP requires Bioconductor package Biostrings R configured Java. Install rRDP database used default RDP classifier. RDP uses Java need working installation rJava package. need Java JDK installed. Linux, can install Open JDK run shell R CMD javareconf configure R using Jave. Windows, can install latest version JDK https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/ set JAVA_HOME environment variable R using (make sure use correct location). example look like : Note double backslashes (.e. escaped slashes) used path. Details can found https://www.rforge.net/rJava/index.html. configure R Java,
code: if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {     install.packages("BiocManager") }  BiocManager::install("Biostrings") install.packages(c('rRDP'), repos = c('https://mhahsler.r-universe.dev')) Sys.setenv(JAVA_HOME = "C:\\Program Files\\Java\\jdk-20")

title: rRDP: Interface to the RDP Classifier
text: RDP classifier developed Ribosomal Database Project (Cole et al. 2003) provides various tools services scientific community data related 16S rRNA sequences. classifier uses Naive Bayesian approach quickly accurately classify sequences. classifier uses 8-mer counts features (Wang et al. 2007).

title: rRDP: Interface to the RDP Classifier
text: RDP can trained using trainRDP(). use example tiny training data set shipped package. Note training data needs names specific RDP format: "<ID> <Kingdom>;<Phylum>;<Class>;<Order>;<Family>;<Genus>" following show name first sequence. use sprintf display first 65~characters fits single line. Now, can train classifier. model stored directory specified parameter dir. test sequences, sample 5 sequences form training data extract subsequences length 500. prediction confidence supplied attribute "confidence". evaluate classification accuracy can compare known classification predictions. known classification stored FASTA file encoded RDP format. can decode annotation using decode_RDP(). Greengenes format can decoded using decode_Greengenes(). Now can compare prediction actual classification creating confusion table calculating classification accuracy. Genus level. Note confidence accuracy values informative since trained classifier tiny data set vignette can created fast. can use larger training set pretrained classifier get informative results. Since custom classifier stored disc can recalled anytime using rdp(). permanently remove classifier use removeRDP(). delete directory containing classifier files. RDP trained 16S rRNA training set. default classifier downloaded first use cached user’s R data directory. uses RDP Classifier 2.14 released August 2023, bacterial archaeal taxonomy training set . 19 (Wang Cole 2024). Since download take , shown executed vignette.

title: Ribosomal Database Project (RDP) Classifier for 16S rRNA — rdp
text: dir directory classifier information stored. object RDPClassifier object. newdata new data classified Biostrings::DNAStringSet. confidence numeric; minimum confidence level classification. Results lower confidence replaced NAs. Set 0 disable. rdp_args additional RDP arguments classification (e.g., "-minWords 5" set minimum number words bootstrap trial.). See RDP documentation. verbose logical; print additional information. ... additional arguments (currently unused). x object class Biostrings::DNAStringSet 16S rRNA sequences training. rank Taxonomic rank classification learned.
